title: Onboarding Manager (f/m/d)
description:
We are looking for an Onboarding Manager who helps new employees and new customers succeed in their first 90 days.

What you'll do
- Own the employee onboarding journey and the welcome programme
- Create learning content and checklists; run orientation workshops
- Collect feedback and improve the journey every quarter

What you bring
- 3+ years in onboarding, L&D or people operations
- Strong facilitation skills in English
- This role is fully on-site at our Frankfurt office; remote work is not possible
